capability.summary: Render one in-memory Jinja2 template with JSON context
capability.description: Constructs a Jinja2 Template directly from the supplied template string and renders it with a JSON object expanded as keyword context, returning the rendered string.
capability.problem_space: One-shot text interpolation and Jinja2 expression rendering from an inline template and JSON object context.

constraint.io_signature: Inputs: inline template string and JSON object string; output: success payload containing the rendered text under rendered.
accepted_inputs: a Jinja2 template supplied directly as text
a JSON-encoded object whose top-level members become template variables
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.jinja2_render", and rendered as the Jinja2-rendered string, despite the declared text artifact type. A caught JSON-context, template-compilation, or rendering exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.jinja2_render", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: creates an in-memory Template with no configured template loader, so it is not a file-based template rendering pipeline
uses Jinja2 defaults, including no automatic HTML escaping and permissive undefined-variable rendering
the context must decode to a JSON object because it is expanded with keyword arguments
the wrapper supplies an empty-object default if the second CLI argument is absent even though the manifest declares that input required
template syntax errors, invalid JSON, and rendering exceptions are returned through the wrapper's error envelope

output_contract.description: Rendered template string returned in the rendered field of the wrapper response.

intent_tags: interpolate JSON object values into text
negative_intents: render a template file using a template directory
validate a template without rendering it

output_contract.description: Rendered template string returned in the rendered field of the wrapper response.
